aggregates.claim: A finite ledger over the exact current collected suite, with every execution ID, primary requirement, input/profile fingerprint, current adjudication, declared phase and evidence class bound into the inventory review. Inventory adjudication is distinct from case approval: explicit current needs-oracle or disputed members remain listed, unapproved and ineligible for qualified passes. Unreviewed, stale or falsely labelled reference evidence cannot be silently adopted. Declared-valid runtime effects, other effects, positive admission controls, undefined-result contexts and invalid-input diagnostics have separate populations. Actual observations are joined by exact ID and compiler configuration without adding an execution or attributing a canonical case to this requirement.
aggregates.limitation: Observational infrastructure only: S4.2-001's facet remains pending until the source/requirement census, complete conforming fixture/oracle inventory and separate processor/dependency qualifications are independently established. No finite run proves the universal processor obligation. A filtered invocation retains all unselected members in its denominator. XFAILs remain failures; skips, unsupported modes, missing profiles, unavailable launchers, unexecuted run effects and provisional observations cannot become qualified passes. A compile/link admission is not execution of an interpretation, and a context-only run is not an assertion about an undefined value. Resource failures do not establish permitted size/complexity limits. Compiler headers, companions, launchers and profile observations describe the selected interface, not ABI certification or universal portability. Paragraphs 7-8 are recommendations, not manufactured mandatory documentation requirements.

review.rationale: Explicit source-context renewal of the unchanged 2083-member inventory after the independently reviewed FORALL source registration in doc/source_audits/batch_110.json, which completes source registration for the whole of Clause 10. All 2083 case bindings, their fingerprints, 2047 raw reviews, 220 older catalogues, 22 links, R402 and the b153c75b baseline remain exact. Only 18 of the 28 scoped base units are newly accounted, because the ten numbered items R1051 through R1056 and C1038 through C1041 were already accounted; 77 new facets remain pending. All 53 Clause 10 catalogues are now reviewed, every content-bearing Clause 10 section has a catalogue, and 338 Clause 10 base units are accounted. FORALL carries the richest processor latitude in Clause 10, so the reviewer derived independently from the source what is required about the final state and what is merely permitted about order, confirming the catalogue draws that line in the same place; the rules about when each right-hand side is evaluated relative to the assignments are the only reason FORALL is testable at all and are neither strengthened nor weakened. Six permissions were verified in both directions: the any-order evaluation and assignment latitude of 10.2.4.2.4 p2, the corresponding pointer latitude of p3, the 10.2.4.4 p1 different-statements permission, and the p2 nested-header dependence. No plan asserts the processor took a particular order, counts function calls, relies on a side effect or observes a temporary. The reviewer audited all 21 diagnostic-obligation facets rather than a sample, including the four C1038 rows sharing identical prohibiting words, the five C1040 pure-procedure rows spanning function reference, defined operation, defined assignment and finalization, and the many-to-one rows checked specifically against purity, index-definition and conformability cross-rejection. Ownership was verified in both directions against 10.2.1.3, 10.2.2 and 10.2.3. Completing Clause 10 source registration is emphatically not completing Clause 10 testing: Clause 10 now declares 1731 facets of which all but a handful are pending, and no Clause 10 fixture has been written. No FORALL execution, canonical link or SourceUse observation is supplied, and no compiler was invoked. The eight substring executions integrated in batch099 remain the latest actual observations. All pending facets, unresolved units, the retained needs-oracle real-BOZ block and every global gate remain open.
